testcase.name: close is idempotent and prevents later generation
generation returns explicit runtime metadata and respects output boundary
public config validates external model and accelerator
close during an active call returns immediately and cancels runtime work
cancellation reaches the active native runtime and provider remains reusable
fewshot history counts toward context preflight
provider rejects output and context overflow before native generation
GPU runtime rejects unsupported ABI instead of changing backend
close and await suspends until native cleanup finishes
metrics opt in propagates to native configuration and preserves actual counters
speculative decoding requires GPU model capability and respects explicit opt out
reasoning stays enabled with a bounded formatting budget by default
overlapping calls are serialized around one runtime conversation
metrics are not exposed without explicit opt in even if runtime supplies them
